description: This file defines a Spring configuration class for setting up event listening and message flow processing in a Spring Batch & Spring Integration context within the Apache Fineract project. It configures an inbound flow for messaging events with logging and interceptors.

classes.name: SpringEventWorkerConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up message listening and processing flow for Spring Batch integration with event-driven messaging.

methods.name: inboundFlow
methods.description: Defines the integration flow that listens for messaging events, logs at DEBUG level, routes to a queue, and applies an input interceptor.

methods.name: eventListener
methods.description: Creates and configures an ApplicationEventListeningMessageProducer that listens for MessagingEvent types.
